name: runtime-debug-toolkit
description: Instrumented runtime tracing and evidence-based debugging skills for Codex, Pi, and compatible AI coding agents.

interface.displayName: Runtime Debug Toolkit for AI Agents
interface.shortDescription: Trace runtime code paths and fix confirmed bugs with log evidence.
interface.longDescription: Instrument runtime behavior with temporary structured logs, capture local NDJSON evidence, locate the responsible code path, and optionally continue through a verified fix and cleanup.
defaultPrompt: Use $trace-mode to trace this runtime behavior with temporary logs and locate the responsible code path.
Use $debug-mode to diagnose this reproducible runtime bug, fix the confirmed cause, verify it, and clean up.
